plan.notes: Source: https://acu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Business-Management-BS.pdf (official ACU Online degree plan, 2026-2027 Academic Year, College of Leadership and Professional Studies, 100% ONLINE, 120 credit hours). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Leadership concentration modeled (PDF also offers Human Resources and Operations concentrations). Caveats: (1) PDF arithmetic is inconsistent: 10 core courses (30 hrs) + MGMT 335 (3) + 9 hrs MGMT concentration + 9 hrs business electives + 56 hrs gen-ed + 16 hrs electives = 123, not 120. Modeled with electives = 13 hrs so the plan sums to the official 120-hour total (51+56+13=120). (2) ACCT 211 prerequisite per PDF: 'ACCT 210 with a grade of C or better' (ACCT 210 placed earlier). (3) Semester placement is a recommended sequence; the PDF does not publish a semester-by-semester layout.
